open_items: Complete native transaction/backend and CLI integrations in their later steps; validate the full runtime/target filesystem matrix in actual CI and target runs.
Native Linux local-filesystem scope is not a distributed/NFS lock or authenticated host identity.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein neuer Hostname oder eine erneut vergebene Prozessnummer DARF NICHT allein die Übernahme eines unbekannten Lock-Eigentümers rechtfertigen.
oracle.scope: Native owner observations and audited transaction-bound takeover retain explicit risk consent for foreign, unverifiable and reused-PID observations. Live owners and occupied native mutexes remain forbidden; a changed owner at the final transfer boundary is preserved. Full CLI integration and authenticated host identity are not claimed.

preconditions: Owned local Linux roots; real competing processes and explicit trusted ownership observations for uncertainty tests.
Explicit transaction-bound host authority; real stopped Linux processes and native root mutex for orphan recovery; independent normative byte oracle.
steps: Acquire shared native exclusion for writer/recovery kinds; recheck exact ownership and journal barriers before audited orphan removal.
Apply existing risk-consent gates to transaction-bound takeover and reject live owners even with risk consent.
Recheck the current owner at the atomic transfer boundary and retain a replacement owner instead of overwriting it.
